releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.4 (Big Update: Pure TikTok Engine, Electric Midnight UI & Smooth Animations)
releaseNotes:
• Focused 100% TikTok Engine: Completely removed Facebook, YouTube, and Video Trimmer clutter for faster, cleaner, and ultra-reliable TikTok downloads
• Electric Midnight Color Theme: Deep obsidian surfaces with electric TikTok Aqua, Neon Coral, Ultra Violet, and Solar Gold accents
• Fluid Jetpack Compose Animations: Directional tab transitions, pulsing live CDN beacons, spring state cards, and animated library items
• Photo Slide Carousel & HD Audio: Interactive horizontal photo slide gallery with 1-tap individual & batch saving plus 320 kbps MP3 audio extraction
• Bug Fixes & Optimizations: Fixed HTTP connection leaks, MediaStore MIME detection, persisted settings toggles, working cache cleaner, and library filters
• Same Production Keystore: Seamless in-app self-update signed with the original CN=TikSave certificate
